Triple Murder Case Verdicts Delivered Years Later

In separate cases, Indian courts have delivered verdicts years after triple murders. In one case, following a meal at a dhaba, three friends were murdered, and after one year, a Dhamtari court issued a decision. In another case, related to the Pavankumar murder, four convicts were sentenced to death 12 years after the incident, where bullets were fired into the victim's home. In a third case, concerning a triple murder in Dhamtari, five convicts received life imprisonment, with the victims' families reacting by throwing slippers at the accused.
